features.title: Farmer selects a profile on first run
features.user_visible_behavior: On first launch, the farmer selects secano, regadío, or both, then selects conventional or ecological production. Completing both choices opens the app.
features.verification: First launch presents both choices, accepts each valid option, and proceeds only after both are selected.
features.notes: First implementation feature. Keep the flow to two clear choices, as defined in CONTEXT.md.

features.title: Profile choices persist between launches
features.user_visible_behavior: After choosing a profile, the farmer can close and reopen the app and continue with the saved choices without signing in.
features.verification: Save each supported profile combination, restart the app, and confirm the same values load.
features.notes: Use a local persistence mechanism appropriate for the shared Android and Desktop targets.

features.title: Farmer can change a saved profile
features.user_visible_behavior: The farmer can reopen the profile choices from the app and replace either saved choice.
features.verification: Change each profile dimension, leave and reopen the profile flow, and confirm the new choices remain selected.

features.title: Farmer can enter a question in the chat
features.user_visible_behavior: After onboarding, the farmer sees a readable chat screen with a text field and a send action.
features.verification: The chat screen opens after profile setup, accepts text, and enables sending only when the question is non-empty.
features.notes: Use plain Spanish labels and large, accessible controls.

features.title: Farmer can start with a suggested question
features.user_visible_behavior: The chat offers suggested questions, and choosing one places it into the question flow for the farmer to submit.
features.verification: At least one configured suggestion is visible, selectable, and submitted as the question text.
features.notes: Suggestions should reflect only topics represented in the verified corpus.

features.title: Official source documents can be indexed
features.user_visible_behavior: The system can make approved BOE, BOJA, and FEGA source material available to the answer pipeline with its source, date, validity, and applicability metadata.
features.verification: Index a small approved fixture set and confirm each indexed record retains its text and required source metadata.
features.notes: Never treat unverified web content or nominal listings as approved corpus material.

features.title: System retrieves relevant official passages with hybrid search
features.user_visible_behavior: For a submitted question, the system combines vector and BM25 results with RRF and returns ranked official passages with source metadata.
features.verification: A retrieval fixture finds the expected official source for a semantic query and an acronym query, with stable ranked results.
features.notes: Use ChromaDB and BM25 as specified by the technical discovery.

features.title: Retrieval respects profile, campaign, and validity filters
features.user_visible_behavior: The system excludes passages that do not apply to the selected profile or campaign and excludes regulations marked invalid.
features.verification: A fixture with matching and non-matching profile, campaign, and validity metadata returns only eligible passages.
features.notes: Resolve the profile transport boundary consistently with the local-only profile constraint before wiring the client to the backend.

features.title: System abstains when retrieved evidence is insufficient
features.user_visible_behavior: When retrieval is below the configured evidence threshold, the farmer receives the fixed referral message and no generated answer.
features.verification: A below-threshold query returns the fixed Spanish referral message and confirms the LLM was not called.
features.notes: Do not invent a threshold value; calibrate it against the golden dataset.

features.title: System generates grounded answers from retrieved passages
features.user_visible_behavior: When adequate evidence exists, the system returns a concise answer based only on retrieved official passages and identifies the supporting source references.
features.verification: A supported question returns a structured answer whose claims and source references are supported by the supplied passages.
features.notes: Use the configured Gemini Flash model behind an interface; keep generation parameters in configuration.

features.title: Backend exposes the question and answer contract
features.user_visible_behavior: The client can send a question to POST /ask and receive a defined response for either a grounded answer or an abstention.
features.verification: Contract tests cover valid questions, grounded answers, abstentions, and malformed requests.
features.notes: Backend implementation is not present in the repository yet.

features.title: Farmer receives the answer in the chat
features.user_visible_behavior: Submitting a question shows a waiting state and then displays the backend answer or a clear recoverable error.
features.verification: A successful response appears in the conversation, a failed request shows a retry path, and the waiting state ends in both cases.

features.title: Answer citations show source details
features.user_visible_behavior: The farmer can match each [n] citation to its official document, article or section, source link, and verification date.
features.verification: A cited answer displays numbered references and each reference resolves to the correct source metadata and date.
features.notes: Use dates supplied by the verified corpus; never substitute the current date for a document verification date.

features.title: Answers display the required legal guidance
features.user_visible_behavior: Answers show the fixed professional-advice notice, and deadline answers also show the cooperative timing reminder.
features.verification: The fixed notice is visible with every answer; the cooperative reminder appears when a deadline is discussed and is absent when irrelevant.
features.notes: Use the exact Spanish wording in CONTEXT.md.

features.title: Critical answers include a literal source passage
features.user_visible_behavior: For critical deadlines, amounts, thresholds, or requirements, the answer includes the literal supporting passage with its source and date.
features.verification: A critical-topic fixture displays the unaltered supporting excerpt, its source, and its date; a non-critical fixture does not enter extractive mode.
features.notes: Criticality comes from verified metadata; do not infer legal figures from unsupported text.

features.title: Farmer can see which topics are covered
features.user_visible_behavior: A coverage screen lists supported topics and makes clear which topics are not yet covered for the selected profile.
features.verification: The screen marks only topics backed by indexed sources as covered and explains uncovered topics plainly.

features.title: Ecological coverage is marked as beta
features.user_visible_behavior: The coverage screen labels ecological topics as beta and explains that this information is still being validated.
features.verification: Ecological coverage displays the beta label and explanation; conventional coverage does not display the ecological beta label.

features.title: Farmer can send feedback on an answer
features.user_visible_behavior: After an answer, the farmer can select a positive or negative rating and optionally explain why.
features.verification: Both ratings and the optional explanation are accepted, sent to the feedback endpoint, and stored without personal identifiers.

features.title: Golden questions enforce answer quality gates
features.user_visible_behavior: Changes to retrieval and answering can be evaluated against verified questions, including source recall, abstention, and unsupported figures.
features.verification: The documented golden dataset runs in CI and reports hit@5, fidelity, and fabricated-figure checks against the agreed thresholds.
features.notes: Build-brief targets include hit@5 >= 85%, fidelity >= 95%, and zero invented figures; these gates do not exist yet.
